findings.explanation: Taiga’s accusation identifying the former pupil’s return is mistranslated as a pain cry.

findings.evidenceJa: 違和感なく溶け込んだ
findings.governingReading: she blended in without any sense of incongruity
findings.explanation: The joke that the impersonation fit seamlessly before instant exposure becomes merely appearing naturally.
A readily translatable costume-based nickname is left as opaque romanized Japanese.

findings.highlight: the power balance was not what I expected
findings.evidenceJa: 予想外のパワーバランスになってきた
findings.governingReading: the balance of power has been developing in an unexpected direction
findings.explanation: The excuse’s ongoing main-story change becomes a completed past mismatch.

findings.governingReading: my pride is on clearance sale
findings.explanation: The exaggerated retail metaphor behind the pupil’s shameless begging is weakened.

findings.governingReading: I’m beggin’ ya, Master, in exaggerated apprentice speech
findings.explanation: The deliberately affected pupil register marking her surrender of pride disappears.
Her mock-celebratory response to emphatic rejection is reduced to ambiguous assent.

findings.evidenceJa: だからタイガってば大っきらい
findings.governingReading: This is exactly why I hate Taiga
findings.explanation: The comic third-person use of Taiga’s name is replaced by ordinary second-person accusation.

findings.highlight: I’m going to take over this place next time
findings.evidenceJa: 問答無用で征服してやる
findings.governingReading: next time she will conquer the dojo by force without discussion
findings.explanation: The pupil’s mock-grand promise loses both coercive certainty and the no-questions qualification.
